<!--
Title: prefix with one tag — [DOC] [FIX] [FEAT] [REFACTOR] [TEST] [CI] [CLEANUP]
Example: [FIX] Correct dimension handling in RBR reader
The squash commit's title is the PR title. Keep it concise.
Write each bullet/paragraph as one continuous line — GitHub soft-wraps.
Delete "Breaking changes" when there are none.
-->

## Summary

What changed and why, in two or three sentences.

## What's changed

- Concrete change (one short line each).

## Breaking changes

Each breaking change and how to migrate (removed/renamed public API or CLI flag, changed signature or parameter meaning, changed output/config layout).

## Tests

What was run, and what new tests cover.
